items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: See, well, the three of us were well acquainted with each other.

ctx.x: Wasn't he with the Civilian Aeronautics Board or something. I remember seeing his picture.
Right. Well, he was doing that in the band here. Another guy was Roger Kahn, he wound up over here at Grumman's.
